summary: Get one component-scoped cache value by key.

input_schema.component_id: string | The canonical component id namespace for the cache key.
input_schema.key: string | The cache key within the component namespace.

component_id.description: The canonical component id namespace for the cache key.

key.description: The cache key within the component namespace.

value.description: The JSON value stored for the key.

ttl_seconds.description: The effective TTL recorded for the key when available.
